label: Monthly public transport pass, all zones (AED)
period: RTA fare table as published, retrieved 2026-09-14
source: Roads and Transport Authority, Nol Fares page (rta.ae/wps/portal/rta/ae/public-transport/Nol-Fares)

fares.cardType: silver (standard) Nol card; gold class is double; students and seniors 50% off

note: The RTA 30-day Nol pass for all zones on a standard silver card. Single trips cost 4, 6 or 8.50 AED depending on zones crossed. A Dubai-wide public transport reference cost, not a per-community figure and not a car-ownership cost (fuel, Salik tolls, insurance are excluded).
